subject: Delay with the volunteer roster
text: As a community member, I am following up after two days because I need to explain the delay with the volunteer roster. The spreadsheet did not sync overnight, so several names never appeared in the shared folder. I noticed this while checking names before the evening meeting and moved everything into the manual sheet. Please accept my apologies; I should have flagged the problem earlier instead of trying to repair it quietly. If you can confirm the phone contacts for the last four helpers, I will complete the assignment and circulate a final version tonight. The main issue was a frozen browser session, and once I reinstalled the app I discovered that two addresses were missing from the import. I am not making excuses, explaining why the delay lasted longer than expected. Please tell me whether the printed handout can wait until this morning for the meeting too.
